sections.heading: Current state
sections.text:
Fuel: 14 left, about 56 turns once you light it.
Here you can: feed it (2 timber), light it.
You set this down. It stays here, with whatever is in it. You can take it up again, or hand it over and leave it for good.
Cooking: no longer hot enough to prepare food.

sections.heading: How to use
sections.text:
Press C beside it. Feed coals with salvaged timber (or feed to full); light it with relight coals, or stoke to feed and light in one action. Once it burns, dry wet gear on it. Cook raw food by choosing cook this stack beside a fire from the food in your pack. Press C beside it and choose rest, or rest until a time of day: the fire keeps burning while you sleep, and the row says how much fuel the night takes. To take it up, move it, name this camp or hand it over, press C beside it. Pack up camp takes up every kit of yours within 4 cells in one action.
Needs: to feed it: salvaged timber (each timber is 10 fuel; it holds up to 30); optional fuel: one dry, stable combustible reagent; pitchpod resin gives 5 fuel, lamp-oil gives 15, up to capacity. Feeding does not light it; volatile mixtures are unsuitable; to light it: a flame to light it from (a burning fire beside you, a lit torch in your hand, or a flint striker); to rest by it: no hostile creature within 8 cells, as for any rest, and a lit fire with fuel enough for the night (it burns about 0.25 fuel for every turn you rest).
Cost and limits: It burns its fuel while it is lit and goes out when the fuel does. Taking it up puts it out. The fuel the night burns is spent. If the fire could not last a normal rest the row is greyed and says what would fix it. Taking it up keeps its contents and fuel. Handing it over leaves it standing, and you can no longer take it up.
Right now you can: feed coals (1 salvaged timber, up to 10 fuel), feed coals to full (2 timber, +16 fuel), relight coals from flame, stoke: feed 2 timber and light it and 6 more. Not now: rest (The fire is out. Light it before you settle down), rest until Dawn (The fire is out. Light it before you settle down).

sections.heading: How to use
sections.text:
Stand beside a finite cooking fire, press C on the fire and choose feed coals with this reagent.
Needs: one dry, plain, stable reagent; its combustible property supplies 5 fuel per item.
Cost and limits: Feeding adds no flame. The menu states the actual gain; surplus beyond the fire's capacity is lost. Volatile, malformed or modified mixtures are unsuitable. Other uses remain available.
Right now you can: press into liquid flask (heat-proofing, 1 coat; 0→1/12).

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Brew the resin into a burning coating, then throw the bottle to ignite a target. Amber resin beads under the papery pods and sticks stubbornly to the fingers.

sections.heading: Use & mechanics
sections.text: Tactical use: Spend one resin to smear an adjacent uncoated creature with sticky pitch, lowering Agility and DV while coated and increasing fire vulnerability. Uninvited use provokes hostility; attacks and movement remain possible. Choose its inventory action while in reach; success costs one action.
